products.name: Guanyin Bodhisattva
products.desc: A serene seated Guanyin Bodhisattva, with a compassionate face and finely detailed flowing robes.
products.long_desc:
Guanyin Bodhisattva in peaceful repose is one of the most beloved statues, recreating the Bodhisattva seated in meditation, serene and at ease. Every fold of the cloud-like robes and every ornamental detail is carved meticulously by our artisans, expressing the compassion and tolerance of the Bodhisattva.
The statue is made from high-grade poly resin, durable in all weather, ideal for home worship or temple spaces. Size, paint and style can all be customized on request.
features: Custom size and style on request

products.name: Statue of Shakyamuni Buddha
products.desc: A large statue of Shakyamuni Buddha, ideal for the main hall and dignified worship spaces.
products.long_desc:
This large statue of Shakyamuni Buddha (2.2m high) is made for the main hall of a temple. The Buddha's face is serene and pure, bearing the marks of a fully awakened one.
Crafted from high-grade AB resin, it withstands sun and rain even when placed outdoors. We also offer turnkey installation and finishing to suit your actual space.
features: Ideal for the main hall of temples

products.name: Shakyamuni in Meditation
products.desc: Shakyamuni Buddha in a meditative posture, peaceful and serene, perfect for home worship.
products.long_desc:
Shakyamuni Buddha in the lotus meditation posture brings a sense of purity and peace to any worship space. With half-closed eyes and a relaxed, serene face, the statue radiates the stillness of an enlightened being.
Crafted with care from poly resin, it has a refined finish and elegant coloring, ideal for home altars or meditation rooms.
features: Tranquil meditation posture with deep meaning
Perfect for home altars and meditation rooms

products.name: Dharmapala Guardian
products.desc: A majestic Dharmapala Guardian holding ritual implements, protecting the temple.
products.long_desc:
The Dharmapala is the guardian protector of the Dharma, usually placed on both sides of the entrance to the main hall. The statue is majestic and commanding, holding ritual implements such as a sword or mace, strong in presence yet still compassionate.
Made from sturdy AB resin, it is suited for outdoor placement in temple grounds and can be combined with other statues to match the space.
features: Can be combined into temple sets

products.name: Guanyin Bodhisattva
products.desc: A standing Guanyin Bodhisattva holding a vase of nectar, radiating compassion.
products.long_desc:
This standing Guanyin Bodhisattva holds a vase of nectar in one hand and makes a blessing mudra with the other, symbolizing boundless compassion. Her face is gentle and serene.
At 1.7m tall, the statue is crafted in fine detail from poly resin and suits the main hall, temple grounds or larger worship spaces. Gold gilding is available on request.
features: Durable poly resin, optional gold gilding
Suits main halls and large worship spaces

products.name: Bodhi Tree Enlightenment
products.desc: A statue recreating the moment of the Buddha's enlightenment under the bodhi tree.
products.long_desc:
This statue recreates the sacred moment when Shakyamuni Buddha attained enlightenment under the bodhi tree. The image of the Buddha in deep meditation beneath the spreading canopy radiates awakening and peace.
Cast in fine bronze with sharp detail and an elegant finish, it is a dignified choice for the main hall or a meaningful spiritual gift.
features: Dignified for the main hall or as a gift

products.name: Maitreya Buddha
products.desc: A joyful Maitreya Buddha, bringing luck, wealth and peace to the home.
products.long_desc:
Maitreya Buddha with his cheerful smile, large belly and cloth sack is a symbol of good fortune, wealth and tolerance. Worshipping Maitreya is seen as a way to bring joy and serenity to the home.
The statue is finely crafted from poly resin with a bright, joyful face and lively colors, ideal for living rooms, shops, offices or home altars.
features: Cheerful smile, symbol of luck and wealth
Ideal for living rooms, shops and offices

products.name: 18 Arhats
products.desc: A set of 18 Arhats with distinct expressions, often placed along temple corridors.
products.long_desc:
The set of 18 Arhats represents the awakened disciples of the Buddha, each with a distinct expression, posture and ritual implement. The set is usually arranged along corridors or in temple lecture halls.
Every statue is hand-crafted, faithfully capturing each face and stance and reflecting the diversity of beings. The durable AB resin material suits both indoor and sheltered outdoor settings.
features: 18 figures, each with unique expression and implement
Suits temple corridors and lecture halls

products.name: Relief of the Life of the Buddha
products.desc: A relief depicting the Buddha's life from birth to entering nirvana.
products.long_desc:
This relief depicts the key milestones of the Buddha's life - from birth, renunciation and enlightenment, to turning the wheel of Dharma and entering nirvana. It is a vivid picture of the journey to awakening.
Created in high relief from poly resin, the figures and settings are rendered in fine detail with real depth. It suits main hall walls, corridors or exhibition spaces.
features: Full narrative of the Buddha's life
For main hall walls and temple corridors

products.name: Relief of Guardian Deities
products.desc: A relief of patriarchs and guardian deities with sharp, lifelike carving.
products.long_desc:
Reliefs of guardian deities and patriarchs are a distinctive art form in temple architecture. Every stroke carved in stone is sharp and lifelike, capturing the true presence of the deities.
Made from natural stone, the work endures for generations and suits temple facades, gateways or surrounding walls.
features: For facades, gates and temple walls

products.name: Ancestor Portrait Statue
products.desc: Portraits of grandparents and ancestors recreated with truth and respect.
products.long_desc:
Ancestor portrait statues are a way for descendants to honor and preserve the image of their loved ones. Every line of the face, every smile and glance is recreated faithfully and respectfully by our artisans.
Statues are made from photographs, from 30cm up to life size, in poly resin or bronze on request, for ancestral altars or living rooms.
features: Poly resin or bronze on request

products.name: Ganesha Statue
products.desc: Ganesha - a symbol of wisdom and good fortune, perfect for interior decoration.
products.long_desc:
Ganesha is the god of wisdom and good fortune in Eastern culture, with the meaningful image of an elephant-headed human body. Ganesha statues are popular in interior decoration and feng shui.
This piece is cast in bronze with refined ornamental detail and an elegant antique finish, ideal for living rooms, desks or art displays.
features: Fine cast bronze, elegant antique finish
Symbol of wisdom and good fortune in feng shui

products.name: Museum Mannequin Statue
products.desc: Reconstructions of historical and cultural figures for museums and exhibitions.
products.long_desc:
Museum mannequin statues faithfully reconstruct historical and cultural figures for display and education. From physique and costume to expression, every detail is carefully researched and recreated.
We accept commissions based on archives, photographs or descriptions, using durable AB resin. Suitable for museums, heritage sites, tradition houses and exhibitions.

products.name: Western Pure Land Trinity
products.desc: The Amitabha - Guanyin - Mahasthamaprapta trinity, dignified for the main hall.
products.long_desc:
The Western Pure Land Trinity consists of three statues: Amitabha Buddha in the center, with Guanyin Bodhisattva and Mahasthamaprapta Bodhisattva on either side. This dignified set is often enshrined in the main hall.
The set is produced as a coordinated whole in AB resin with harmonious proportions and gold gilding. Sizes can be adjusted to suit the actual space of the temple.
features: Sizes adjusted to the temple space
